name: AppCard
intent: A marketplace app-store listing card — icon, status badge, title, description, and an action footer.

lineage.authoredBy: Group C of the missing-widgets template review (2026-08-26)
lineage.confidence: unset — intent taken verbatim from the module's own doc comment; contract not yet enumerated
notes: Was exported from @corensystem/coren-ui with no manifest at all, so it did not exist to the builder, to library-index.json, or to any agent selecting components.
Stub by design: the intent is accurate, the data contract is not yet authored.

props.name: icon
props.description: Branded app icon/logo — an ``, an SVG, or a sized lucide icon.

props.name: name
props.description: App name. May be a string or a node (e.g. a search-highlighted fragment).

props.name: badge
props.description: Status shown at the top-right (e.g. an "Installed" `Badge`).

props.name: actions
props.description: Footer action row — typically two equal-width buttons (Details + Install). Wrapped in a flex row.

props.name: descriptionLines
props.description: How many lines of description before truncation. Defaults to 3, keeping card heights aligned.

props.name: ...props
props.description: All standard HTML attributes are supported.

usage: Use AppCard to structure and organize content within your interface. This component helps create visual hierarchy and consistent spacing throughout your application.
AppCard works well for arranging related content, creating responsive layouts, and maintaining visual consistency. Use it to group related elements and establish clear content boundaries.

anatomy.description: AppCard is composed of the following parts:

parts.name: AppCardContent
parts.description: Main content area of the card.

bestPractices.title: Maintain consistent structure
bestPractices.description: Use the same card layout pattern throughout your application.

bestPractices.title: Don't mix card styles
bestPractices.description: Avoid using different card structures for similar content types.

bestPractices.title: Use appropriate elevation
bestPractices.description: Apply shadow/elevation that reflects the card's importance and context.

bestPractices.title: Don't over-elevate
bestPractices.description: Avoid heavy shadows on every card, reserve for interactive or important items.

bestPractices.title: Keep content scannable
bestPractices.description: Structure card content for quick scanning with clear hierarchy.

bestPractices.title: Don't cram too much
bestPractices.description: Avoid overloading cards with excessive content or actions.
